RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel alone is not evidence of sex discrimination. Modern public broadcasters heavily prioritize digital transformation; eight years of newsroom experience combined with strong digital expertise can legitimately outweigh longer tenure in a traditional deputy role. 

Raising the panel's gender composition without concrete evidence of bias would appear speculative and could seriously damage your professional reputation within the organization. Furthermore, a two-week delay for formal HR feedback is common bureaucratic practice, not an indicator of impropriety. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting your interview feedback, focusing strictly on competency criteria and identifying which areas—such as digital media strategy—you can develop for future leadership openings.
